baseline_governance.historical_evidence_corpus: All suitable prior structured observations, never assumed normal.
baseline_governance.nominal_reference_baseline: Only explicit reference-candidate sessions that have not produced indexed anomaly observations.

check_priority_categories.deferred: Another evidence-tied check is prioritized, so this check can be reviewed later without being removed.
check_priority_categories.insufficient_evidence: Historical compatibility is too weak to prioritize or defer the check.
check_priority_categories.priority: History shows recurrent or persistent comparable evidence for the check family.
check_priority_categories.relevant: The check remains tied to current evidence, but history does not justify prioritization.

compatibility_requirements.decoder: Decoder version key must match when available.
compatibility_requirements.detector_rule_version: Detector/rule versions must match when both records expose a comparable version.
compatibility_requirements.independence: The current session, same sample hash, and same source path are excluded.
compatibility_requirements.operating_context: Operating contexts must match when both current and historical records expose one; otherwise the comparison is limited.
compatibility_requirements.recording_quality: Historical session must be evaluation-ready with at least one window.
compatibility_requirements.signals: Current observation required signals must be available in the historical session.
compatibility_requirements.temporal_order: Only sessions captured before the current session may be considered.
compatibility_requirements.vehicle_source: Vehicle identity must match when available.

recurrence_categories.first_observed: Compatible prior sessions exist, but no materially similar prior observation was found.
recurrence_categories.historical_comparison_unavailable: No compatible prior sessions or required comparison metadata are available.
recurrence_categories.persistent_across_sessions: A materially similar observation occurred in at least three prior comparable sessions and in at least half of all comparable prior sessions. This is a conservative recurrence category, not a degradation claim.
recurrence_categories.rare_recurrence: A materially similar observation occurred in exactly one prior comparable session.
recurrence_categories.recurrent: A materially similar observation occurred in at least two prior comparable sessions.

trend_categories.insufficient_historical_data: Fewer than three compatible numeric occurrence points are available.
trend_categories.no_observable_trend: Numeric occurrence points are not monotonically increasing or decreasing.
trend_categories.possible_decreasing_trend: At least three compatible numeric points decrease monotonically in detector-local severity semantics.
trend_categories.possible_increasing_trend: At least three compatible numeric points increase monotonically in detector-local severity semantics.
